title: (THF)8Ln8E6(EPh)12 Cluster Reactivity: Systematic Control of Ln, E, EPh, and Neutral Donor Ligands

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 cube with face-capping E2- and edge-bridging EPh

synthesis.procedure: Under N2, Sm was added to PhSeSePh and Hg in THF. After 5 h stirring the metal dissolved. Sulfur was added and the color changed from red to olive. After 3 days the solution was filtered, concentrated to ca. 30 mL, and layered with hexanes to give light yellow crystals.
synthesis.time: 5 h to dissolve metal; 3 days after sulfur addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, concentrated to ca. 30 mL, layered with hexanes (15 mL) to give light yellow crystals

properties.summary: Light yellow crystals; the yellow color of sulfido clusters is assigned as characteristic of Sm(III) rather than Se2- to Sm CT, in contrast to intensely colored Sm selenido clusters.

source_locations.location: Experimental Section elemental analysis; Table 1 empirical formula (asymmetric-unit formula C52H62O4S3Se6Sm4)

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 cube with face-capping E2- and edge-bridging EPh

synthesis.procedure: Under N2, Sm was added to PhSeSePh and Hg in THF. After 3 weeks PhSSPh was added to the dark brown mixture; within 1 h the solution turned orange. After 2 days the solution was filtered, concentrated (ca. 25 mL), and layered with hexanes to give orange crystals.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature; color change within 1 h after PhSSPh addition
synthesis.time: 3 weeks before PhSSPh addition; 2 days after addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, concentrated to ca. 25 mL, layered with hexanes (25 mL) to give orange crystals

properties.summary: Orange crystals; intensely colored Sm8Se6(EPh)12 clusters attributed to Se2- to Sm(III) charge-transfer absorption. No electronic absorption maximum was observed in THF between 320 and 800 nm.

source_locations.location: Experimental Section Anal. Calcd; Table 1 empirical formula C116H148O11S12Se6Sm8
Experimental Section UV-vis; Abstract and Discussion CT assignment

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 cube with face-capping E2- and edge-bridging EPh

synthesis.procedure: Sm, PhSeSePh, and Hg were added to pyridine and stirred for 2 days at room temperature. Elemental Se was added to the light brown solution. After 10 days the bright orange solution was filtered, concentrated to 30 mL, and layered with hexanes to give orange crystals.
synthesis.time: 2 days before Se addition; 10 days after Se addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, concentrated to 30 mL, layered with hexanes to give orange crystals

properties.summary: Orange crystals; intense color assigned to Se2- to Sm(III) charge-transfer absorption. Electronic spectrum in pyridine shows λmax = 450 nm.

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 cube with face-capping E2- and edge-bridging EPh; isostructural with 3

synthesis.procedure: Nd, PhSeSePh, and Hg were added to pyridine and stirred for 2 days. Elemental Se was added to the light green solution, stirred for 5 days, and filtered to separate a green/gray precipitate. The solution was concentrated to ca. 30 mL and layered with hexanes to give pale green blocks of 4.
synthesis.time: 2 days before Se addition; 5 days after Se addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: drybox or Schlenk techniques under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered to remove green/gray precipitate; concentrated to ca. 30 mL; layered with hexanes (20 mL) to give pale green blocks

properties.summary: Pale green/light green-blue color characteristic of Nd complexes; absence of visible charge-transfer absorptions supports assignment of intense colors of Sm selenido clusters 2 and 3 as Se2- to Sm CT rather than SePh-based transitions.

source_locations.location: Abstract; Results and Discussion color/CT assignment for 4

material_class.structural_family: Ln8 cube with face-capping S2- and edge-bridging SPh

synthesis.procedure: Sm, PhSeSePh, and Hg were added to THF and placed under H2. After 3 days stirring, H2 was replaced with N2. PhSSPh was added to the dark brown solution; 3 days later elemental sulfur was added to the light brown solution. After 2 days the brown mixture was filtered to remove an insoluble brown precipitate, concentrated to ca. 25 mL, and layered with hexane to give yellow crystals of the all-sulfur cluster, identified by color and unit-cell determination at -120 °C (matching the previously reported cluster).
synthesis.temperature: ambient; identification at -120 °C by unit cell
synthesis.time: 3 days under H2; 3 days after PhSSPh; 2 days after S addition
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered to remove brown precipitate, concentrated to ca. 25 mL, layered with hexane to give yellow crystals

properties.summary: Characteristic light yellow color of Sm(III) sulfido clusters; used with other light-colored sulfido/Nd analogues to assign intense Sm selenido colors as Se2- to Sm CT.
